create_balancer_with_weights: create a Balancer instance with weighted loss coefficients for gradient balancing during training
run_balancer_backward: run the Balancer backward method to compute balanced gradients from multiple losses and model output
review_balancer_metrics: review the Balancer metrics property to inspect gradient ratio statistics for each loss component
build_balancer_without_grad_balance: build a Balancer with balance_grads disabled to use standard weighted sum of partial gradients
test_balancer_per_batch_item: test the Balancer per_batch_item option to compute averaged gradient norms per batch item
